text:
deploy-bot: 🚀 Canary rollout started: service=runtime-api, env=staging, tag=v1.12.3-canary, commit=abc1234def, initiator=@alex.nguyen, plan=10% traffic for 10m then evaluate. CI artifacts: s3://releases/v1.12.3-canary

alex.nguyen: Kicking this off now. Monitoring dashboards up (link: https://grafana/re/redwood/runtime-api). I'll watch p95 latency and token error rate.

maya: Quick smoke ran on sample requests — generation quality checks OK. p50/p95 both within expected baseline (+1ms p95).

liam: Routing update applied: traffic split -> 10% canary / 90% stable. Rule: cost-prefer region fallback enabled.

ops-oncall: Noted. Enabling extended logs for canary instances: `RL_ENV=staging DEBUG=runtime:kvcache` for next 12m.

sara: Heads up — small uptick in model cache misses observed on canary nodes (~0.8% -> 1.9%). Might be startup churn. No user-facing errors yet.

alex.nguyen: Holding at 10% while cache warms. If error rate >1.5% for 3m we will revert.

maya: Synthetic evals running against the canary set: 200 prompts, rouge/bleu-ish checks pass, no regressions flagged.

deploy-bot: Canary mid-check at +6m: health=PASS, error-rate-token=0.6%, p95-latency=+3ms. Metrics payload: `{"success":true,"p95_delta_ms":3}`

liam: Gradual ramp plan: move to 30% now, monitor 5m, then to 70% if stable. Applying traffic patch.

alex.nguyen: Patch applied. Also pinning runtime version for canary tag: `runtime: v1.12.3-canary (pinned)` so we can rollback cleanly.

ops-oncall: Note: removed kv-cache debug after warm-up. Logs look clean.

deploy-bot: Traffic shift complete: now 30% canary. Next check in 5m.

maya: After ramp to 30% p95 still +3-4ms, no increase in token errors, quality matches baseline.

sara: Seeing occasional 429s from an auxiliary upstream at 30% — investigating whether client-side throttles need bump. It's ~0.02% of requests.

alex.nguyen: Decision: Proceed to 70% since errors are marginal and not model-related. If upstream 429s grow we cap and open rollback.

liam: Rolling to 70% now.

deploy-bot: Canary complete: final health=PASS, p95_delta_ms=+4ms, token_errors=0.7%, upstream_429=0.03%. Recommendation: promote to production tag `v1.12.3`.

alex.nguyen: Approve promotion. Creating release note draft and tagging commit: `git tag -a v1.12.3 -m "runtime: stable promote from canary" abc1234def`

maya: I'll kick off final CI smoke in prod preview and coordinate with release engineer for the change window.

ops-oncall: Backup plan if we see regression in first 30m: immediate pin back to `v1.12.2` and open incident channel #incidents. Also prepped rollback script: `./deploy rollback --tag v1.12.2`.

deploy-bot: Promotion started: target env=production, tag=v1.12.3, strategy=staged ramp (5% -> 20% -> 100%). Will post updates on each step.

alex.nguyen: Thanks team. I'll stay on call for the first 30 minutes of the production ramp. :thumbsup:
